regime.label: Dealer gamma flipped short across the whole ladder - net board GEX -1,653.0 from +174.5, no gamma flip left between 960 and 1,150, cumulative GEX -6,313.8 at spot - as 1,043.1 broke 6.9 points under a 1,050 max pain that had held ten sessions, on doubled volume and a 1.44-point IV expansion
evidence: -1,653.0 net board GEX today against +174.5 on 10-20 is a dealer-gamma sign flip, and no strike on the 960-1,150 ladder carries a positive cumulative sum any more (the flip was 1,150 yesterday, 1,110 on 10-16). Cumulative net GEX reads -6,313.8 at spot, the deepest of the window, and troughs exactly at the 1,040 ATM strike - below 1,050 dealer hedging amplifies the move rather than fading it.

6.9 points below the 1,050 max pain, 1,043.1 is the first break under a pin that held for ten consecutive sessions, delivered on -11.6 points (-1.10%, the largest one-day fall of the window against -8.9 on 10-09) with volume doubling to 3,270 lots (1,688 call / 1,582 put) and ATM IV expanding 1.44 to 12.17%. Volume plus IV confirming the break is the Vol2Vol signature of real flow beating the option structure.

+547.4 of local GEX inside 20 points of the money is carried almost entirely by one strike - 1,050 at +825.8 - against -565.4 at 1,030, -1,096.5 at 1,020 and -1,477.4 at 1,000. A one-strike-thick shelf sitting above spot, down from a +1,575.3 peak on 10-16 and +1,219.8 yesterday, is a corridor, not support.

1,905 contracts at the 960 put wall traded only 72 lots and sit 83.1 points (8.0%) below spot - structural insurance that fails Vol2Vol. The live levels are 1,000 (1,260 put OI, +188 today, the board's heaviest put volume at 263 lots, and the 25d put strike) and 1,050 (1,219 call OI on 346 total lots); the 1,397-contract 1,100 call wall drew just 110 lots at 5.5% away, and the near call wall has migrated down to 1,050.

S50Z26.today_summary: 1,043.1 on the December future is -11.6 points (-1.10%) and 6.9 points below a 1,050 max pain that has now held for ten consecutive sessions - the first break under the pin since 10-09. Net board GEX flipped to -1,653.0 from +174.5 and the gamma flip dropped off the 960-1,150 ladder entirely: cumulative net GEX reads -6,313.8 at spot, the deepest of the window, troughing exactly at the 1,040 ATM strike. ATM IV jumped 1.44 to 12.17%, the window high, lifting the implied 1-sigma day to 7.99 points (0.77%) from 7.13, while total volume doubled to 3,270 lots and OI built +1,056 to 20,151. The +547.4 of local GEX inside 20 points of the money is one strike thick - 1,050 alone carries +825.8 - against a short-gamma corridor of -565.4 at 1,030, -1,096.5 at 1,020 and -1,477.4 at 1,000.
what_changed: Net board GEX flipped sign: -1,653.0 today from +174.5 on 10-20, and the gamma flip vanished from the 960-1,150 ladder (1,150 yesterday, 1,110 on 10-16) - cumulative net GEX is now negative at every listed strike.
Spot broke below the pin: 1,043.1 sits 6.9 points under the 1,050 max pain after eight straight sessions closing above it, on -11.6 points, the largest one-day decline of the window.
ATM IV expanded 1.44 points to 12.17%, the window high, out of the 10.73-11.61% band held for eight sessions; the 1-sigma day widened to 7.99 points from 7.13.

Near-money walls migrated down: near call wall 1,100 -> 1,050 (1,219 OI) and near put wall 1,040 -> 1,000 (1,260 OI, +188 contracts on 263 lots), while put OI built +539 in total, concentrated at 1,000 and below.
S50Z26.five_day_thesis: The 1,050 max pain has been fixed for ten sessions (10-06 onward, down 30 points from 1,080 on 09-26) and the 1,100 call and 960 put outer walls have not moved once in the window, so the structural frame is intact - what broke today is the dealer-gamma sign. Local GEX inside 20 points built from +86.8 on 10-09 to a +1,575.3 peak on 10-16, then decayed to +1,219.8 and now +547.4, while cumulative GEX at spot deepened from -3,770.3 on 10-16 to -6,313.8: the stabilising shelf thinned for four sessions before price fell through it. IV traced 11.27% on 10-09 to 11.61% on 10-15 to a 10.73% low on 10-20 and 12.17% today, so the compression that justified short-vol into yesterday unwound in a single session. OI has risen every session of the window, +4,279 contracts since 10-07 to 20,151, with today's put build sitting at 1,000 and below - a protection book still being assembled, which makes this a short-gamma break inside a growing book, not an Unwind. At 69 DTE and only 6.9 points from the pin this is not a confirmed max-pain failure, but with volume doubling and IV expanding into the break, the mechanical case for fading back to 1,050 is weaker than at any point in the window.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1030 / 1000
strategies.rationale: Trades with the break rather than against it: the short-gamma corridor runs -565.4 at 1,030 to -1,477.4 at 1,000, where dealer hedging amplifies downside, and 1,000 is the live put line (1,260 OI, +188, 263 lots) and the 25d put strike, so the 43.1-point distance is 5.4 one-sigma days of room.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit ~7.75 points (16.25 mid paid, 8.50 mid received); max value 30 points at or below 1,000.
strategies.invalidation: A reclaim of 1,050, the single strike carrying +825.8 of positive GEX - above it dealers dampen again and the pin case returns.

strategies.name: Call credit spread 1070 / 1090
strategies.rationale: Sells the richest point of the near-money surface - 13.29% on the 1,070 25d call against 12.17% ATM - 26.9 points (3.4 one-sigma days) above a spot that just lost its shelf, and into the one region where dealers are still long gamma (+285.2 at 1,070, +494.0 at 1,090) and therefore dampen upside.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 20-point width minus ~4.95 net credit = ~15.05 points. Short-vol payoff is negative-skew, so this is the small-size leg, not the core.
strategies.invalidation: A close above 1,070, or a reclaim of the 1,080 strike (1,170 call OI, +111 today, 320 lots) which would mark upside flow taking the positive-GEX shelf back.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1000 / 960 (tail hedge)
strategies.rationale: Cheap defined-risk insurance for the case where the corridor opens past the live 1,000 line all the way to the static 960 wall (1,905 OI, 8.0% below), which is exactly the path short dealer gamma would accelerate; 12.19% IV on the 1,000 put is the cheapest put vol on the near-money board.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit ~4.95 points (8.50 mid paid, 3.55 mid received); max value 40 points at or below 960.
strategies.invalidation: A reclaim of 1,050 with net board GEX back positive - the hedge premise is the negative cumulative GEX at every strike, so a sign flip back removes it.

S50Z26.prediction: Bias is lower-to-choppy while 1,043.1 holds under 1,050: with cumulative GEX negative at every listed strike and troughing at the 1,040 ATM, dealer hedging now amplifies moves instead of damping them, and the 7.99-point 1-sigma day puts 1,035 and 1,027 inside one and two sessions. The level that matters on the downside is 1,000 - 1,260 put OI, 263 lots, -1,477.4 GEX - not the static 960 wall 8.0% away. A reclaim of 1,050, the one strike carrying +825.8 of positive GEX, invalidates the bias and restores the ten-session pin.
S50Z26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no position size is implied. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical delivery, so the 1,050 max-pain magnet and any pin is a tendency, not a guarantee - structurally weaker than for share-settled single stocks, and macro or news flow can override the option structure outright. Defined-risk is not risk-free: the ~7.75-, ~15.05- and ~4.95-point max losses above are real and can be lost in full, and short-vol structures carry negative skew - small frequent gains against rare large losses.
